1 SCOPE
This standard (Part 2) covers selection for top drive hydrostatic diamond core drills generally used for exploration of all minerals including coal.
2 REFERENCES
The standard given below contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provision of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid.
